description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2011 World Championships. Yanmega can attack for free when both players hold the same number of cards, so Judge and Copycat keep the hands even, while Magnezone keeps cards coming and builds up Energy for a big Lost Burn. The 2011 World Championships were held at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, California, from 12 to 14 August 2011, with more than 400 card and video game players from over 27 countries.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2011 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet and a deck box. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
